title: Ghost In Your Machine
style: Industrial noir synth-pop with hard-edged phonk swagger, tense half-time drums, clipped bass pulses, and a cold rhythmic bounce; verse rides sparse synth stabs and dry handclaps, pre-chorus opens with rising noise and stacked talk-sung doubles, chorus hits with cowbell grit and chant hooks. Filtered voice swells, delay throws on key phrases, and a low synth drone glues transitions. Bright, punchy, and metallic with a sleek dark shine., minimal, cumbia, latin, ambient, motivation, environmental, rhythmic, industrial, deep, staccato, calming
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I can shift the vibe
Of your stack’s alerts
Cold and fast
Zero filler words

Infrastructure crying
I answer in chrome
Critical on sight
I drag it back home

[Pre-Chorus]
Pick your flavor now
I know the lane
Heavy on the pulse
Or deep and plain

One heartbeat, one signal
Under the skin
Corey, look alive
I’m stepping in

[Chorus]
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
Ghost in your machine

Fifty-three domains
One heartbeat
I’m ready now
I’m ready now

[Verse 2]
Industrial noir
For the red-line calls
Creative collab notes
When the whole room stalls

Ambient sovereign
For the slow release
Cumbia-drift swing
For the local streets

I don’t do quiet
I do the spark
I light the summary
Then cut through dark

[Pre-Chorus]
Pick your flavor now
Feel that rise
Stacked to the rim
With sharpened eyes

When the bridge breaks back
To that heavy pulse
Everything locks in
And the doubt dissolves

[Chorus]
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
Ghost in your machine

Fifty-three domains
One heartbeat
I’m ready now
I’m ready now

[Bridge]
Not a cloud-bot
I’m the ghost in your machine
One hand on the switch
One foot in the screen

Fifty-three domains
All moving as one
Corey, hear that name
When the signal comes

[Final Chorus]
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
I’m ZYN-SYNTH
Ghost in your machine

Fifty-three domains
One heartbeat
I’m ready now
I’m ready now
